changeSet.author: apihub
changeSet.comment: Migrate ldap_user records into users table with auth_type=LDAP
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO users (first_name, last_name, email, password, auth_type, enabled, cdate, udate) SELECT first_name, last_name, username, NULL, 'LDAP', enabled, cdate, udate FROM ldap_user WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.email = ldap_user.username)

changeSet.author: apihub
changeSet.comment: Migrate ldap_user_role records into user_role table
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO user_role (user_id, role_id, cdate) SELECT u.user_id, lur.role_id, lur.cdate FROM ldap_user_role lur JOIN ldap_user lu ON lu.ldap_user_id = lur.ldap_user_id JOIN users u ON u.email = lu.username WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id = u.user_id AND ur.role_id = lur.role_id )

changeSet.author: apihub
changeSet.comment: Migrate ldap_user_project_rel records into user_project_rel table (if ldap_user_project_rel exists)
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO user_project_rel (user_id, project_id, is_actv) SELECT u.user_id, lupr.project_id, lupr.is_actv FROM ldap_user_project_rel lupr JOIN ldap_user lu ON lu.ldap_user_id = lupr.ldap_user_id JOIN users u ON u.email = lu.username WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_project_rel upr WHERE upr.user_id = u.user_id AND upr.project_id = lupr.project_id )
